paper_title: APT Improving Specialist LLM Performance with Weakness Case Acquisition   and Iterative Preference Training
caption: The exploration of hyperparameters.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the effect of the hyperparameter $\alpha$ on model accuracy (%) for the Dolly model, as part of a hyperparameter exploration. The x-axis, labeled $\alpha$, is a numerical scale ranging from 0 to 4, with tick marks at 0, 2, and 4. The y-axis, labeled Accuracy (%), is a numerical scale ranging from 22.75 to 23.75, with major tick marks at 22.75, 23.00, 23.25, 23.50, and 23.75. The data is represented by a single line with teal-colored circular markers. The line starts at an accuracy of approximately 22.8% when $\alpha = 0$, rises sharply to a peak of 23.75% at $\alpha = 1$, and then trends downward, ending at an accuracy of approximately 22.8% when $\alpha = 4$. A legend in the top right corner, labeled "Dolly," identifies the plotted line.
